verdict.rationale: Vercel documents separate local, preview, production, and custom environments, each with its own variables. That lets a devops lead keep production credentials and endpoints out of preview deployments, but this is configuration-level separation rather than enforced network isolation. Deployment protection (Vercel Authentication, passwords, trusted IPs) controls who can reach preview URLs, not what those environments can reach outbound. Missing for 10: network-level egress isolation of non-production from production services, a private networking or secure-compute boundary per environment, documented guarantees that preview cannot reach production resources, and independent corroboration.
